answer: A submitter whose answers share 5 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 31% of its pending payouts meanwhile. The thread detector writes each match to the sparrow queue, and the beacon checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. That is 11 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
